svg.aria-label: Nikhil Pawar: DevOps, cloud infrastructure and SRE. Three and a half years running the AWS account behind HP's device-telemetry platform. Now an MS CS student at Northeastern University in Seattle. The drawing shows device telemetry flowing through Kinesis into a petabyte-scale, five-tier lake.
